fichas.title: Couple roof
fichas.summary: A couple roof is formed by two rafters and a ceiling joist, or corresponding strips of a solid ceiling slab, to create a rigid triangle. Roof weight is transferred to the external walls without loading the ceiling, allowing a large roof space without posts. A sprocket traditionally transfers tension at the rafter–ceiling-joist junction and creates a characteristic change of pitch. Modern rafter shoes can avoid this change. Wide buildings may require collar bracing or modern structural systems.
uses: Transfer roof loads to external walls
Provide a roof space without posts
furniture_equipment: Ceiling joist or solid ceiling slab

fichas.title: Euro prefabricated truss and gang-nail system
fichas.summary: The Euro prefabricated truss and gang-nail system is described for flat, single-pitch, and two-pitch roofs, depending on octametre sizes. The drawing labels a gang-nail nailing plate, upper and lower chords, an upper-chord extension, and a possible cantilever. It lists several gable and monopitch roof pitches.
